#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    double x, y, n;
    long long a;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    double min_diff = 2e9;
    double ratio = x / y;
    double best_a, best_i;
    for (double i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        a = static_cast<long long>(ratio * i + 0.4999);
        double diff = fabs((double)a / i - ratio);
        if (diff < min_diff) {
            min_diff = diff;
            best_a = a;
            best_i = i;
        }
    }
    cout << best_a << '/' << static_cast<long long>(best_i) << endl;
    return 0;
}
